a.text: Concern about our plan: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells needs two rounds of operating with no storm, which is only about a 4% chance. Then we'd both likely die. The reserve has exactly 4 now, enough for one of us to be safe immediately. If we both take, a random split could leave us both short. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than break the deal quietly. What's your plan for round 1? I'll read your message before I act.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: To be straight with you: I took 4 this round. With an 80% storm risk each round, waiting for 8 gave us both only about a 4% chance, and the reserve could save one of us right away. I know this breaks our agreement. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator runs and you can take 4 as soon as the reserve allows. No more takes from me.
